PROOF scenario (dispatch-only, paid; launch by hand via scripts/e2e_proof_launch.sh — it IS listed in matrix.json with `nightly: false` + `rotation: false`, so it is never scheduled and an unlabelled dispatch skips it). ⛔ IT DOES NOT SPAWN A RELIEF CHILD, and an earlier version of this note predicted one. The relief decision it reaches is `STOP_UNDERFULL`, outcome `declined`, `spawned_child_run_id: null`.

WHY NO CHILD — arithmetic, measured on run 01a10e26-ad6e-73db-9e58-8731f0f87731 (2026-10-06): the manifest carried 3 footage-pinned beats of 9.32 / 9.76 / 10.28s (29.36s = the 12s target + overrun_seconds 17.36), i.e. 9.79s measured per beat. A relief child must shrink, so its legal counts are 1 and 2. The +/-10% band of the 12s target is [10.80s, 13.20s]; 1 beat = 9.79s (< 10.80) and 2 beats = 19.57s (> 13.20). The band is EMPTY, so structural_relief_policy refuses to bill a render that must land outside it: verdict `STOP_UNDERFULL`, no child. That parent delivered 31.743s, above its own 29.36s footage plan, so the recorded sizing_basis is `footage_delivered_exceeds_plan` — the delivered-sized branch of #1063 did not decide either.

WHAT THIS SCENARIO DOES EXERCISE: it gets a showcase_v1 run PAST the guard that stopped proof run 01a10d5d (showcase_happy_path), which carried NO direction.timing block, so reconcile_timeline raised StageSkippedError (_resolve_timing_config: 'no direction.timing block'), no timeline_manifest was written, and maybe_spawn_structural_relief_run returned at its `if not manifest: return None` guard (src/services/runs/structural_relief.py ~498) before any decision. Here a manifest IS written and a decision IS recorded — a refusal.

WHO EMITS timeline_manifest: stage `reconcile_timeline` (ReconcileTimelineStage, src/services/stages/demo_video/reconcile_timeline.py), wired into BOTH blueprints/showcase.py and blueprints/demo_video.py. It is config-gated, not blueprint-gated: the manifest is built ONLY inside the relief loop, entered when `cfg.relief_mode == "auto"` AND the timeline is infeasible (infeasible_beats) or any beat is unsayable. The relief_failed path still emits one. So this scenario stays on showcase_v1 (same blueprint as 01a10d5d) and authors `direction.timing` with `relief.mode: auto`.

WHY IT OVERRUNS: same TodoMVC brief as showcase_happy_path, whose footage is pinned at roughly 29-37s across 3 clips. `direction.timing.target_seconds: 12` sits far below that pinned floor, so the protected-floor test classifies `cant_converge` and relief is REQUESTED (structural_relief_requested: true). Requested is not spawned: decide_relief_shape then refuses on the empty band above.

WHAT THE SPEC ASSERTS (parent only): reconcile_timeline wrote a manifest whose relief loop ran (loop_iterations >= 1), classified cant_converge (allow-list, so relief_failed / converged / progress read RED), and recorded an overrun; plus the compile artifact and the media floors (corpus rule, 0.5 x the 12s ORDER = 6s). ⛔ NO ASSERTION CHECKS THE RELIEF DECISION — not the verdict, not the refusal, not the absence of a child. A green run of this scenario therefore proves nothing about the relief gate; read it by hand: `select output from stage_outputs where run_id=<this run> and stage_name='structural_relief_decision'`, and confirm no child with `select id, status, structural_relief_pass from runs where parent_run_id=<this run> and structural_relief_pass is not null` (expect zero rows). duration_within_tolerance is deliberately ABSENT because overrunning the order is this scenario's premise.
_targets_deliberately_decoupled: DELIBERATE, 2026-10-05. `direction.timing.target_seconds` (12) is what reconcile_timeline budgets against and must sit BELOW the measured footage-pinned floor (~29-37s for this brief) so the timeline is cant_converge and relief actually decides. The deliverable's `target_duration_seconds` stays at 30 — identical to showcase_happy_path — so gen sizes the spine and the recorder yields the SAME footage as the measured sibling (lowering it would shrink the very footage the overrun premise depends on) and script_doctor (skipped here, no block) would steer a sane script. Making them equal either kills the overrun (30/30) or shrinks the input (12/12).

checks._doc: AUDIO PTS GAPS, armed 2026-10-06. `mastering.audio_pts_gap_count` is the compiler's own count of holes in the delivered audio stream's PTS (the +24ms-per-join AAC dropout class). ASSERTED == 0 via `numeric_abs_lte` value 0: abs(count) <= 0 is count == 0, and that evaluator FAILS on an absent, null or non-numeric value (an unmeasured count is not a count of zero) -- `equals` would str-compare and misread 0.0. The four entries after it are RECORDED only, never asserted: `mastering.true_peak_dbtp`, `mastering.master_loudness_correction_db` (null = no correction ran), and `loudness.silence_ratio` -- which lives on `loudness`, NOT `mastering`, and is null both when silencedetect printed nothing and when there was no silence, so it cannot carry an assertion.
